name: protege-mais
description: Base inicial do projeto Protege Mais.

scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.mjs drizzle.config.ts --max-warnings 0 && turbo run lint
scripts.db:up: docker compose up --build -d db redis atlas-db minio minio-setup
scripts.atlas:hash:docker: docker compose run --rm -T -e ENV atlas sh -eu -c 'atlas migrate hash --env "${ENV}"'
scripts.atlas:run:docker: docker compose run --rm -T -e ENV atlas sh -eu -c 'atlas migrate apply --env "${ENV}"'
scripts.atlas:run:auto: if command -v atlas >/dev/null 2>&1; then pnpm run atlas:run; else echo 'Atlas CLI nao encontrado. Usando Docker (atlas).' && pnpm run atlas:run:docker; fi
scripts.atlas:diff:docker: docker compose run --rm -T -e ENV atlas sh -eu -c 'atlas migrate diff --env "${ENV}"'
scripts.atlas:status:docker: docker compose run --rm -T -e ENV atlas sh -eu -c 'atlas migrate status --env "${ENV}"'
scripts.atlas:validate:docker: docker compose run --rm -T -e ENV atlas sh -eu -c 'atlas migrate validate --env "${ENV}"'
scripts.atlas:run:dev:docker: docker compose run --rm -T -e ENV atlas sh -eu -c 'atlas migrate apply --exec-order non-linear --env "${ENV}"'
scripts.seed:local: pnpm run migrate:local && ENV=dev pnpm run atlas:run:dev:docker
scripts.seed:new:local: ENV=dev docker compose run --rm -T atlas atlas migrate new --env dev
